lead.description: the estimation of a prediction or description rule from data, separating error a better rule could remove from error the measured features cannot remove

overview_sentence: [Machine learning](articles/machine-learning.qmd), in the statistical sense, estimates a prediction or description rule from data.

self_checks.title: Reducible plus irreducible
self_checks.prompt: A fixed fit has f(X)=10, f-hat(X)=7 and error variance 9. What is the expected squared error?

self_checks.title: Perfect fit
self_checks.prompt: If that same fit recovers f(X)=10 exactly, and the error variance is still 9, what is the expected squared error?

self_checks.title: Another fixed fit
self_checks.prompt: Now f(X)=4, f-hat(X)=1 and the error variance is 4. What is the expected squared error?
